company_name: Zoppas Industries Heating Element Technologies IRCA SPA
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Zoppas Industries provides heating elements and thermal systems that are integral to various processes in the semiconductor manufacturing value chain.
summary: Zoppas Industries Heating Element Technologies IRCA SPA specializes in designing and producing heating elements and systems with a focus on electronic controls. Their offerings include integrated assemblies and thermal sensors, which are crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company supports custom design and prototyping, enhancing product development and innovation within the semiconductor sector.
